local:pinned-here-global-stays-on-latest.title:
Pinning fnox in this repo's `[tools]` means the shim resolves to the
pinned version INSIDE this directory while the global install stays on `latest`
— an accepted skew, chosen deliberately so this repo states the fnox it expects.
Bump the two together; a bump here alone narrows the skew rather than closing it,
and the global side is not this repo's to edit (`do-not.md` #11).

RE-PROBED 2026-08-03 at the 1.31.1 -> 1.32.0 bump: the skew is UNCHANGED and
still accepted. 1.32.0 is purely additive (credential proxy, `exec --replace`,
Azure App Configuration provider, AWS IAM role assumption) with no change to how
a pinned shim resolves. Checked and explicitly NOT true: it does not address
knowledge-base #74 (`env="exec"` silently emptying env-var credentials) —
`exec --replace` is a new process-replacement MODE, not a fix to that path, so
#74 stays open. **The global fnox bump is still owed** and is Ray's to make.
